en: Fixed a turn ending with "API Error: EPROTO: The TLS handshake failed" when the connection broke partway through a reply; the partial reply is kept or the request is retried, as before 2.1.302
zh: 修复了回复中途连接断开时，回合以“API Error: EPROTO: The TLS handshake failed”结束的问题；现在会保留部分回复或重试请求，与 2.1.302 之前的行为一致
